meta.system: ARES-MED v5.0 Clinical Decision Support Config
meta.disclaimer: DECISION SUPPORT ONLY: ARES-MED is an educational prototype using simulated telemetry inspired by published NASA Human Research Program (HRP) studies. Not a certified medical device or diagnostic tool.

transit_0g.label: Spacecraft in Transit (0.00g)
transit_0g.emphasis: Cephalad fluid shift (SANS), radiation storm shelter readiness, strict closed-loop CO2 monitoring.

station_leo.label: Orbital Space Station (0.00g LEO)
station_leo.emphasis: Daily ARED resistive exercise logging, EVA readiness, near-real-time flight surgeon link.

lunar_base.label: Lunar Surface Habitat (0.16g)
lunar_base.emphasis: Lunar regolith dust ocular/respiratory irritation, partial-gravity vestibular adaptation, EVA workload.

mars_surface.label: Mars Base / Rover (0.38g)
mars_surface.emphasis: Maximum Earth-independent autonomy, 24h 39m Mars sol circadian alignment, long-duration isolation.

referenceRanges.name: Resting Heart Rate
referenceRanges.yellowRange: +12 to +19 bpm above baseline or 7d upward slope
referenceRanges.redRange: >105 bpm sustained or paired with red-flag symptoms
referenceRanges.source: AHA / NASA HRP Baroreceptor Adaptation Literature

referenceRanges.name: Core Body Temperature
referenceRanges.source: NASA HRP Thermoregulation / Stahn et al.

referenceRanges.name: Daily Sleep Duration
referenceRanges.redRange: < 5.0 h or multi-day cumulative sleep debt

referenceRanges.name: Cumulative Career Radiation
referenceRanges.redRange: > 480 mSv or active Solar Particle Event (>2.0 mSv/d)
